summary: Frontend-only Iteration 5 health check passed. All five extended fetchpriority patches were verified in source and at runtime across Home, About, How It Works, Security, and Spezial-AIF: 0 fetchPriority warnings. The exact six-route traversal produced 47 console errors versus 49 in Iteration 4, matching removal of the two remaining warnings; the residual 39 network errors and 8 SVG path errors are the explicitly allowlisted baseline noise. All seven prior-green regression groups passed, as did the Home showcase guard and silent unauthenticated News behavior. Frontend unit tests (139/139) and production build passed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scoped acceptance and regression groups passed

seed_data_creation: None. UI forms were filled but not submitted; visitor consent/profile state was stored only in browser localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 exact traversal of /, /news, /comparison, /login, /about, and /legal/impressum measured 47 console errors: 39 browser network failures (34 Supabase 401s plus 5 known external-logo failures), 8 known SVG path errors, and 0 fetchPriority warnings; there were 0 uncaught pageerrors. Runtime traversal of /, /about, /how-it-works, /security, and /spezial-aif found valid lowercase fetchpriority DOM attributes and zero related React warnings. Home made zero requests to all eight NotificationCenter tables and zero showcase-user requests. News rendered 24 article/detail links with zero uncaught JS/page errors. Home had 77 inspected local images with zero visibly broken assets. Welcome persistence, theme persistence, desktop News/Wissen/Unternehmen navigation, login/register inputs, and mobile menu/no-overflow checks passed.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior warnings were caused by React 18 receiving camel-case fetchPriority props. All remaining image call sites now emit lowercase fetchpriority, including dynamic high/low values in SpezialAif, so React passes the attribute through without warning. The console total decreased by exactly two (49 to 47), while the explicitly excluded Supabase/network and SVG baseline remained unchanged. PortfolioHeroChart now filters normalized rows unless `at` is a valid Date; this did not eliminate the eight known showcase SVG errors, indicating those residual paths originate elsewhere in the showcase chart stack rather than from invalid PortfolioHeroChart dates.
